# Creator Instructions

**Before you start working on your brief make sure to: File \> Make a Copy**
**Please do NOT edit this doc as it's just a template**

1. Shoot vertically (9x16 or Reels dimension)
2. Record at 1080p or higher (1080x1920). **Disable HDR**
3. Use the back camera of your phone for sharper quality (even for talking heads if possible)
4. Always film in a well-lit space:
   * Natural light is best, but bright artificial light is fine as long as it's not overexposed.
   * Avoid dark or poorly lit footage
   * Avoid direct harsh light hitting the lens (or filming too close to the light source)
   * For reference, try to keep the lighting as close to these examples as possible: [sample 1](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DNJIypysazC/), [sample 2](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DLOEoUDOliZ/) (unless otherwise stated in the shot instructions)
5. Add an extra 1–2 seconds to the start and end of each clip (we'll trim during editing)
6. Do not add music, captions, filters, or color grading
7. Turn off fans, ACs, or other loud devices before filming
8. For shots that require expressions, keep it natural - no exaggerated "TV commercial-style" acting. Aim for realistic expressions/reactions

### **For talking head or script reads:**

1. Film in a space that feels natural to you (your home, office, or any everyday setting). Avoid studio setups, or anything that looks overproduced
2. Hold the phone steady (tripod, phone stand, or propped securely at eye level).
3. Unless otherwise instructed, keep your head centered in the frame - not too high or low ([sample 1](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DNJIypysazC/), [sample 2](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/aiKDwiSn0jQ), [sample 3](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/WqtNAtBRkOE), [sample 4](https://www.instagram.com/reel/C6ep3pnBNcO/))
4. The read should **NOT** sound like an ad. Reword some lines if you need to so they sound natural in your voice, just keep the main point
5. *Lines in italics* are just notes/instructions, not part of the actual script

**When saving assets:**

1. Upload all raw files to this folder (do not downscale quality): [CLICK HERE](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1PX5wMxMl6g5lCPvKbd1EOIxcURoxjoyq?usp=sharing)
2. Name each file according to its B-roll number and title. Example: **B-Roll 1 - Shower shelf**
   * If the B-Roll requires multiple clips, number them: *B-Roll 1 - Shower shelf (1)*, *B-Roll 1 - Natural tag (2)*, and so on **OR** put them inside a folder named after the B-Roll title
   * For the talking head/script read, label the file as Talking Head. If there are multiple clips, number them: Talking Head 1, Talking Head 2, etc.

*See next section for further instructions*

### **For this specific shoot, you'll need:**

*Local Revival body wash in **Lavender**, label and ingredient list readable*

*Your real night routine props: pajamas or robe, towel, a lamp or dim light, your phone (to put away), your bed made*

*A shower or bathroom shelf where the bottle can sit on camera (steam is fine, keep the lens clean)*

---

**Notes:**

*UGC style: you, your home, your real routine. Selfie-style talking to camera for the hook, routine and CTA, with B-roll of the routine in between. Warm, low, cozy light for the evening shots (lamp, not overhead).*

*Voice: **cozy**. Soft, slow and quiet, like you're telling a friend in bed, almost a whisper-talk. Small pauses between phrases, relaxed shoulders, no hype and no "ad" energy. Reword any line so it sounds like you, just keep the point.*

*Total runtime: ~30 seconds.*

---

**Claim guardrails (read before filming):**

* The video is about **your routine**. The soap is a **pleasant part of it** (the scent, the ingredients).
* **Do say:** "my wind-down routine", "I love how it smells", "made with essential oils", "I get into bed smelling like lavender."
* **Do NOT say:** that the soap or the scent "helps you sleep", "relaxes you", "calms you", "reduces stress/anxiety", "treats insomnia", or call it "aromatherapy." Sleep or relaxation claims about a scented product can make it a drug claim under FDA rules, even with plant-based ingredients.
* General sleep hygiene tips (consistent routine, phone down, warm shower before bed) are fine as **your habits**, not as a promise of what the product does.

---

**Script:**

| Script Section | Lines | Instructions |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **HOOK** (0–4s) | Before bed, my favorite choice of product and scent is this one. | *Selfie-style, in pajamas or robe, lamp on, bedroom or bathroom. Bring the Lavender bottle up to the lens on "this one", label facing camera. Soft voice, slight smile.* |
| **ROUTINE** (4–13s) | It's part of my wind-down. Phone down, lights low, a warm shower. Same order every night, that's really what sleep hygiene is about. | *Cut to B-roll while you speak (voiceover is fine): putting the phone face down, turning off the overhead light and turning on the lamp, turning on the shower.* |
| **PRODUCT** (13–23s) | This is Local Revival in lavender. Essential oils, tallow, raw honey, nothing synthetic. And I get into bed smelling like actual lavender. | *Talk to camera holding the bottle, then B-roll: bottle on the shower shelf, lather in hands, close up of the ingredient list on the back. End with you in bed, smelling your arm or shoulder, natural reaction.* |
| **CTA** (23–30s) | Ten scents to choose from, but lavender is my night one. 15% off today, link below. | *Back to camera, bottle next to your face. Point down toward the link on "link below".* |

---

**Alternative hooks (pick one to test):**

* "The part of my night routine I never skip."
* "I stopped scrolling in bed and started doing this instead."
* "Everyone talks about sleep hygiene, but nobody talks about the routine. Here's mine."
